title: Quick Homemade Sous Vide Vanilla Extract
description: If you have a sous vide circulator you can make your own homemade vanilla extract overnight.
ingredients: 3 vanilla bean, split lengthwise and halved

steps.text: Fill a large pot with water and place a sous vide circulator into the water. Set temperature to 140 degrees F (60 degrees C) according to manufacturer's directions.
Place vodka and vanilla beans into a sterilized pint-size Mason jar and secure with lid until finger-tight. Lower into the water, ensuring jar is completely covered, and process for at least 8 hours.
Remove jar. Cool and store in a dark cupboard, gently shaking occasionally. The extract is ready to use immediately, but the longer it sits, the better it will become.
